I love watches. I own 10. And since I received my Apple Watch in May, I've worn none of them (which include a Pebble Steel). I have 3 bands for my Apple Watch, I can change the face easily, so pretty much daily I have a new watch. I have also received multiple compliments on the watch's looks. I don't get how some can argue it's ugly, but I guess that comes down to personal taste.

I don't use it for anything fancy. I get my notifications, check the weather, keep up with how I am doing on walking/standing throughout the day and not much else. Was I expecting some James-Bond-laser-through-cement feature? No. I was expecting a device that displayed my notifications, time, and other tidbits of information. Can I do these things on my phone, certainly. But I'm in an environment where I can't always pull my phone out. I also enjoy the benefit of being at home and not having the know where my phone is at all times because I get the notifications on my AW.

The Apple Watch has already sold more than the entire smartwatch industry did in 2014. How can 1 product outsell an entire industry and still be considered a flop as some are stating.

I think, as I stated previously, Apple is in a tough spot due to their success. But as consumers, people have to understand not all products are for them. As much as you like Apple, it doesn't mean the product is meant for you. And if you don't like Apple, or think their products are stupid, useless, pointless, then that is fine too. But the Apple Watch is the perfect product for a lot of people. And I am one of them.
